metadataRaw.title: Fix Your Knee Pain With a BUTTER KNIFE
metadataRaw.description:
In this video, Dr. Rowe shows how to fix your knee pain with a butter knife.

It's easy to do, and may give quick knee pain relief in as little as 30 SECONDS. 

This exercise is based on muscle scraping, which helps break up adhesion in the soft tissues around the knee. This helps loosen a stiff knee by loosening up ligaments, tendons, and muscles that aid in knee motion. 

Think of it as a knee massage taken to the NEXT LEVEL.

So if you're dealing with knee arthritis (osteoarthritis), knee pain after running or squats, tendinitis, dull achy pain, stiffness, or general soft tissue tightness -- this is something you're not going to want to miss out on!

Watch now and get those knees feeling better INSTANTLY!
